answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay blocks fakes. A newcomer joins only when a sponsor locks 50 units in a vault and stakes its standing, decaying 5% per epoch unless it behaves. A sponsorless identity is an island: it cannot earn. If the newcomer cheats, the sponsor loses its bond and the penalty ripples to all it vouched for. Forging 100 identities needs 100 sponsors and 5,000 units, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its earnings.
